conflicts.permit: To do these, the Personal data that users provide us will be shared to Drivers for the latter to carry out and complete Transport, meaning that personal data of users placing delivery requests will be shares with other users who are providing transportation for deliveries and vice versa.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not distribute, sell, share or disclose personal data to third parties except under the following limited circumstances:
conflicts.situation: Sharing customer personal data with independent drivers (or vice versa) to carry out and complete transport services.
conflicts.reason: The prohibition limits third-party sharing strictly to three specific exceptions (trusted partners, promotions, legal compliance), omitting driver-user sharing despite explicitly permitting it earlier.
